verdict.rationale: Better Auth's homepage claims "Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation," which is a first-party claim directly on this story's axis. The only detailed agent-auth doc describes the MCP plugin making your app an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients; that covers inbound authorization, not obtaining delegated tokens for third-party APIs. missing for 10: documentation of a token vault or token exchange that issues short-lived, user-consented tokens for third-party APIs, details of how agent delegation works, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
